name: ApplyConditionalFormatting
label: Apply Conditional Formatting (HTTP)
description: Applies conditional formatting to a range of cells.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The relative path to the Excel workbook in the OneDrive or SharePoint drive (e.g., 'Reports/Dashboard.xlsx').

fields.name: WorksheetName
fields.label: Worksheet Name
fields.description: The name of the worksheet containing the range to apply conditional formatting to (e.g., 'SalesData').

fields.name: RangeAddress
fields.label: Range Address
fields.description: The A1-style cell range to apply conditional formatting to (e.g., 'B2:B100' or 'A1:D50').

fields.name: RuleJson
fields.label: Conditional Formatting Rule (JSON)
fields.description: A JSON string defining the conditional formatting rule. Must follow Microsoft Graph Excel conditional formatting schema (e.g., {"type":"cellIs","operator":"greaterThan","formula":["100"],"format":{"fill":{"color":"#FF0000"}}}).
